data.listing_age_source: complete BaoStock daily file rows before point-in-time index membership filtering

methodology.signal: completed daily state only; no future event/price fields
methodology.entry: next available open; locked upper-limit session is unfilled
methodology.horizons: entry T+1 open to T+2/T+3/T+6 open for 1/2/5d labels
methodology.baseline: same-date eligible universe average executable return
methodology.parameter_policy: broad pre-registered thresholds; no threshold search
methodology.promotion_policy: daily screen only promotes information; minute-required hypotheses are not trade-ready

H01.title: weak-regime veto
H01.notes: Same active-core family; non-weak market should dominate weak market.

H02.title: panic-to-repair
H02.notes: Tests collective repair versus merely being individually oversold.

H03.title: climax avoidance
H03.notes: A successful veto means climax chasing is worse than non-climax core states.

H04.title: novelty-emergence
H04.source_cluster: 赵老哥/作手新一/陈小群
H04.notes: Current industry event proxy is provisional; true event text is a later upgrade.

H05.title: breadth-with-leader
H05.source_cluster: 主线/合力/热点中的热点
H05.notes: Leader plus broad participation versus isolated strong stock.

H08.title: role persistence
H08.source_cluster: 赵老哥/养家/陈小群/作手新一
H08.notes: Persistent role versus same-day strength without prior role evidence.

H10.title: amount acceleration sweet zone
H10.source_cluster: 放量/资金合力/分歧成交额
H10.notes: Pre-registered moderate acceleration; >2x is reported separately as possible distribution.

H11.title: turnover sweet spot
H11.notes: Tests inverted-U intuition rather than optimizing one turnover threshold.

H13.title: price-under-10 placebo
H13.notes: Modifier/placebo only; never a standalone trading trigger.

H15.title: trend pullback
H15.notes: Strong-trend pullback versus similarly weak recent return in a downtrend.
